title: Point the build2 grader tests at grading.json and remove grading-new.json
item: Make new-format/grader/tests/test_grade_build2.py grade with the default grading.json instead of grading-new.json, replace test_grade_skips_unknown_kind (it asserts grading.json has no build2 kind) with a skip test on a kind grading.json still lacks (standin-check, results/standin-1), then delete the superseded grading-new.json
motivation: Task 028 made build2 live in grading.json, so test_grade_skips_unknown_kind now fails (1 of 34 grader tests), and grading-new.json is a second copy of the build2 measurement kept only because these tests name it
notes: Found while building task 028. The test file is protected (new-format/grader/), so task 028 could not change it.
done_means: uv run pytest eval/agent-spec/new-format/grader/tests passes; no test names grading-new.json; grading-new.json is gone; grading the baseline (grade.py eval/agent-spec --labels switch-base-10,switch-base-11,switch-base-12) prints the same table as before.
draft_note: Drafted by the task-028 builder. Owner fields are a proposal; priority left for the owner.
